newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-July trade deficit 257.3 bln forints.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-July trade deficit 257.3 bln forints.

text.p: Hungary's foreign trade deficit widened to 257.3 billion forints in January-July, up 10.7 billion from the same period last year, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Tuesday.
Hungary's seven-month imports amounted to 1,333.3 billion forints, up 260.8 billion from the same period last year, the KSH said.
Exports were 1,076.0 billion forints, up 250.2 billion from the same period last year, it said.
In dollar terms the January-July deficit was $1,744.8 million, down $349 million from the same 1995 period, the KSH said.
